jobs.title: Director Digital Solutions & Business Growth
jobs.description:
Since 1953, Empower Simcoe has specialized in providing a wide range of programs and services for people and families throughout Simcoe County. We are looking for innovative, passionate, and dedicated employees. Our inclusive culture empowers all of us to Be, Belong and Thrive. If you are looking for a career where you can make a difference and feel proud of the work you do every day, you've come to the right place. Your future starts now at Empower Simcoe!


Empower Simcoe is searching for a bold, visionary **Director Digital SolutionsBusiness Growth** to drive our digital revolution! In this high\-impact role, you will spearhead our innovation agenda\-scouting emerging tech to modernize our ecosystem, supercharge service delivery, and elevate the daily employee experience. You won't just track sector trends; you will anticipate them. Collaborating directly with senior leadership and the Director of Information Technology, you will bridge the gap between business strategy and execution, ensuring our organization stays agile, modern, and fiercely future\-focused. If you live and breathe tech innovation, get excited about the boundless potential of artificial intelligence, and love turning complex data into real\-world organizational superpowers, this is the sandbox you've been looking for.

**Compensation Package:**

* Minimum starting rate of $49\.54 per hour; $96,603 annualized.
* 11 paid statutory holidays are observed.
* 4% vacation pay paid bi\-weekly during probationary period.
* Confidential employer paid Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members.




**Following the successful completion of probation:**

* Employer paid benefits (life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability benefits, health and dental).
* Group RRSP plan with Employer matched benefit up to 5% of gross earnings biweekly.
* Employer paid sick, personal leave and vacation time.
* Opportunity to work remotely up to 60% of scheduled hours.




**Minimum requirements of these positions include**:

* Proven successful completion of a degree or diploma in information technology, computer science, web development, business systems, or other related discipline, or an acceptable equivalent combination of education, skills and experience as determined by the employer.
* Minimum of 5 years progressive full\-time work experience in information technology, digital solutions, business systems.
* Demonstrated experience with design, development, and implementation of transformation initiatives, business development and purchased services.
* Established skills in developing and designing standards\-compliant, accessible web sites is required.

**The job duties listed below are an overview of the minimum requirements of the position. The individual will be responsible for, but not be limited to:**

**Strategic LeadershipBudgeting**

* Drive innovation by leading AI initiatives and digital transformation.
* Co\-author the Digital Solution roadmap in partnership with the President and CEO.
* Advise senior executives on emerging technology trends and future capabilities.
* Foster a data\-informed culture across the organization.
* Manage the Digital Solutions budget to optimize costs and IT expenses.




**Digital Solution ArchitectureDelivery**

* Translate business needs into concrete technical software requirements.
* Design and implement platforms while evaluating security, integrations, and user training.
* Assess digital capabilities to mitigate risks and identify improvement gaps.
* Collaborate with the IT Director to align solutions with existing tech capabilities.




**CommunicationsWeb Platforms**

* Co\-manage web ecosystems by handling platform technology, user experience, and search engine optimization, while Corporate Communications handles messaging.
* Advance equity, diversity, inclusion and accessibility initiatives across all social, web, intranet, and podcast platforms.
* Oversee digital assets to ensure information accessibility and seamless online campaigns.
* Coordinate with IT on infrastructure, security, and web system dependencies.




**Purchased ServicesBusiness Growth**

* Directly oversee the Manager Business Growth to boost portfolio performance.
* Scale purchased services using automation, technology, and data analytics.
* Explore new revenue streams through digital offerings and social enterprise models.
* Partner with the Chief Transformation Officer to adapt to market and sector trends.




**People ManagementSupervision**

* Manage direct reports including the Power ApplicationsArtificial Intelligence Lead and the Manager Business Growth.
* Drive a high\-performance culture through active hiring, continuous coaching, and succession planning.
* Ensure compliance with all Agency Standards of Practice and training mandates.




Empower Simcoe is committed to a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone feels respected and valued. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or disability. Applications are encouraged from those who reflect the diversity of our community.




**SUBMIT APPLICATION TO:** https://empowersimcoe.prevueaps.ca/jobs/

**We thank all those who apply for this position. However, only those applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.**


Empower Simcoe is committed to being non\-discriminatory and providing equal and barrier\-free selection and appointment processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to this position, please let us know if you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process. Our inclusive culture empowers all of us to Be, Belong and Thrive.

**Please note that incomplete applications will not be considered. If you have any issues with the application process, please contact the People and Culture Department at** careers@empowersimceoe.ca

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Leader – Consulting / Managing Partner
jobs.description:
Data \& AIHybridFull\-timeID: REQ\-43710
 N2P Systems
Toronto, Ontario, Canada 10\+ years From $135K CAD Posted Today
  
**Role Overview**
-----------------


N2P Systems is seeking an experienced Data \& Analytics Consulting Leader to join our enterprise technology delivery team in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. At N2P Systems, you will put 10\+ years of hands\-on experience with Enterprise Data Strategy, Enterprise Data Architecture and Data Governance to work on mission\-critical enterprise systems. This is an existing full\-time, hybrid vacancy with N2P Systems.


N2P Systems is seeking an accomplished Data \& Analytics Consulting Leader to drive enterprise transformation, strategic consulting, and business growth across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector. This senior leadership position combines enterprise data strategy, analytics, artificial intelligence, cloud modernization, and consulting expertise.


The successful candidate will shape strategic client relationships, identify business opportunities, lead complex transformation engagements, and translate enterprise challenges into measurable business outcomes. The role requires substantial experience in Data, Analytics, AI, and consulting, alongside a proven record of growing business and delivering large\-scale transformation programs.


N2P Systems uses AI to help screen and assess applications for this role. N2P Systems is an enterprise technology consulting and digital solutions firm operating across Canada, the United States and India.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Develop strategic relationships with Chief Data Officers, CIOs, Chief AI Officers, business executives, and senior technology stakeholders.
* Advise BFSI organizations on enterprise data strategy, analytics transformation, AI adoption, governance frameworks, operating models, and modernization initiatives.
* Convert business challenges into actionable transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Facilitate executive workshops, discovery meetings, steering committees, and strategic client discussions.
* Drive Data, Analytics, and AI business growth, covering opportunity identification, qualification, proposals, commercial negotiations, and deal closure.
* Shape large consulting and transformation engagements by defining solution direction, value propositions, commercial strategies, and delivery roadmaps.
* Lead RFP responses and proactive proposals, ensuring solutions are differentiated, commercially viable, and outcome\-oriented.
* Develop collaborative business opportunities with account teams, technology partners, alliance partners, and consulting practices.
* Define target\-state enterprise architectures and strategies spanning cloud data platforms, data products, analytics, AI/ML, Generative AI, governance, and Responsible AI.
* Recommend modernization strategies involving leading cloud providers, data platforms, and emerging technologies.
* Ensure enterprise transformation initiatives address scalability, security, privacy, resilience, cost optimization, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide executive oversight throughout opportunity development, engagement mobilization, delivery, and business value realization.
* Establish governance mechanisms covering project scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, commercial commitments, quality, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure effective transition from pre\-sales to delivery, with clearly defined ownership, commitments, and success criteria.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary consulting, architecture, engineering, analytics, and AI teams across different locations.
* Contribute to senior talent acquisition, capability development, succession planning, and leadership mentoring.
* Create reusable consulting offerings, reference architectures, case studies, estimation models, executive presentations, and delivery playbooks.
* Represent the practice in strategic client, partner, and internal leadership engagements.
* Develop strategic reference customers and contribute to sustainable revenue growth.
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
-------------------------------------


* At least 18 years of professional experience spanning Data, Analytics, AI, and Consulting, with a demonstrated history of business growth and enterprise transformation delivery.
* Strong expertise in enterprise data strategy, architecture, operating models, data products, governance, and modernization.
* Demonstrated success in delivering measurable ROI and business outcomes across the complete Data\-to\-Insights value chain.
* Strong understanding of data engineering disciplines, including ETL/ELT, integration, APIs, data quality, orchestration, observability, and platform engineering.
* Experience directing enterprise analytics and business intelligence initiatives, including reporting, self\-service analytics, semantic layers, and decision intelligence.
* Broad understanding of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, Responsible AI, and enterprise AI transformation.
* Experience defining and delivering enterprise\-scale solutions using modern cloud data platforms and technologies.
* Strong understanding of BFSI requirements, particularly regulatory compliance, data privacy, security, resilience, auditability, and risk management.
* Established experience in consulting, business development, pre\-sales, solution development, opportunity qualification, proposal development, and commercial support.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, geographically distributed teams and manage complex enterprise transformation programs.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data, Business, or a related discipline.
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Master's degree or MBA.
* Experience with Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake.
* Exposure to Agentic AI, MLOps, LLMOps, Responsible AI

jobs.title: AVP, CXO Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
Vous êtes aussi unique que votre parcours, votre expérience et votre point de vue. Ici, vous serez encouragé, habilité et défié à être à votre meilleur. Vous travaillerez avec des collègues dynamiques – des experts dans leurs domaines – qui sont désireux de partager leurs connaissances avec vous. Vos leaders vous inspireront et vous aideront à atteindre votre potentiel et à vous envoler vers de nouveaux horizons. Chaque jour, vous aurez de nouvelles et passionnantes occasions de rendre la vie plus brillante pour nos Clients – qui sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.  



  

Chez Sun Life, nous sommes guidés par notre Raison d'être : aider nos Clients à réaliser la sécurité financière à vie et à vivre une vie plus saine. Nos valeurs façonnent notre façon de travailler : bienveillance, authenticité, audace, inspiration et impact.  



  

Quand vous vous joignez à Sun Life, vous travaillez avec des collègues passionnés et des leaders habilitants qui soutiennent votre croissance et célèbrent vos contributions, afin que vous puissiez faire une différence significative dans la vie de nos Clients.  



  

Découvrez comment vous pouvez faire une différence dans la vie des personnes, des familles et des communautés du monde entier.  



  

**Description de poste:**

**Role Summary**

  

Reporting to the Vice\-President, Experience, Planning and Transformation, CXO, the AVP, CXO Strategy \& Transformation will help drive the development and stewardship of an integrated CXO vision and Client platform strategy and execution within CXO and across SL Canada.


This role will act as a senior strategic integrator across the CXO mandate—bringing together strategy, transformation, performance reporting, analytics, to tell a cohesive story. The successful candidate will help build insights discipline, and change capability required to simplify how CXO works, sharpen decision\-making, and ensure investments are clearly linked to client, advisor, sponsor, business, risk, and financial outcomes.  



  

The role requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, business management, financial and analytical acumen, executive\-level communication and pragmatic execution. The candidate will be expected to work closely with CXO leadership, Canadian business partners, Finance, Technology, and Global partners, and senior stakeholders to develop a cohesive CXO\-wide narrative, strengthen performance management, programmatically manage spend and priorities, and ensure the function is operating with appropriate risk, auditability, and governance standards.


This is a high\-impact role for a proven strategy and transformation leader who can connect the dots across complex domains, turn data into insight, create structure from ambiguity, and help move a large, multi\-disciplinary function from reporting activity to driving measurable action.  



**What will you do?**

* **Shape and steward the Client Experience Office strategy and transformation agenda** , connecting priorities across client experience, engagement, digital, marketing, data and business partners.
* **Build the transformation capability and operating disciplines** needed to move strategy into execution, including governance, prioritization, metrics, decision forums and management routines.
* **Lead an insight\-driven performance approach** , partnering with Data and Finance to connect business, client, financial, operational and risk information to executive decision\-making.
* **Modernize performance management and executive reporting** , creating monthly and quarterly business reviews that clearly connect strategy, investments, initiatives, outcomes, risks, dependencies and decisions.
* **Guide portfolio and investment prioritization** , helping ensure resources and spend are aligned to strategic priorities, client and business outcomes, sales enablement and risk reduction.
* **Develop executive\-level strategic narratives and recommendations** for senior leadership and Board\-level audiences, simplifying complex issues and clearly articulating progress, trade\-offs, risks and required decisions.
* **Advance the Client Experience Office’s AI strategy** , helping leaders determine appropriate areas for investment, experimentation, capability development and leadership attention.
* **Lead through influence across a complex matrix** , partnering with Finance, Technology, Data, Digital, Marketing, Operations, Risk and business leaders to strengthen alignment, simplify ways of working and accelerate execution.

**What you’ll need to succeed?**

* 10\+ years of progressive experience in strategy, transformation, business management, consulting, financial services, client experience, operations, technology enablement or related corporate leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting enterprise transformation, strategic planning, portfolio management, executive governance or performance management.
* Experience working with senior executives and senior governance forums, including the development of concise, decision\-oriented executive and Board materials.
* Ability to translate complex business, financial, technology, risk and client information into clear strategic recommendations and executive narratives.
* Experience designing or improving performance\-management frameworks, business reviews, scorecards, dashboards or executive reporting.
* Strong financial and analytical capability, including experience interpreting cost structures, investment trade\-offs, technology spend, operational metrics and business performance.
* Demonstrated success partnering across Technology, Finance, Data, Digital, Marketing, Operations, Risk and business teams within a complex, matrixed organization.
* Experience leading teams, developing talent and improving operating models or ways of working.
* Strategic problem solving and the ability to identify the implications behind quantitative and qualitative information.
* Sound judgment and the ability

jobs.title: Associate Director / Director, Financial Advisory
jobs.description:
**The Financial Advisory Team at Teneo**
----------------------------------------


Teneo’s global Financial Advisory business advises corporates, creditors and other financial stakeholders in situations of financial stress and distress. No two situations are the same. Our advice and approach is tailored to each situation and each client. At Teneo, we believe such occurrences present new opportunities for our clients. Opportunities to restore value, raise new capital, pivot in a new direction and ultimately, identify certainty amidst chaos. Teneo partners with clients to find viable opportunities that will protect and enhance value and help them to build strategies that will most benefit their business and/or investment goals.


Integrating the disciplines of financial advisory, management consulting, investor relations, strategic communications, government affairs, risk analysis and talent advisory, Teneo’s global Financial Advisory team guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress. We help address the challenges a business faces, whether that is targeted performance improvement to Financial Advisory, or delivering a route to recover value, our focus is delivering certainty from uncertainty.


Teneo is expanding its already established global Financial Advisory footprint, now in Canada. The Canadian Financial Advisory team will join forces with the already established Strategy and Communications platform which has offices in Toronto, Montreal and Calgary. We are hiring at several levels.


**The Role – Associate Director, Toronto**
------------------------------------------


This is an excellent opportunity to work alongside our established team who will support you to utilise and enhance your advisory skills and experience. You will work alongside some of the most experienced practitioners in the field advising the boards, management teams, lenders and shareholders of companies which are underperforming and/or facing any financial stress.


As an Associate Director / Director in the team, you will have the opportunity to work and lead on a diverse range of engagements across all sectors, with plenty of responsibility for leading workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting Directors and Managing Directors in client\-facing delivery.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Client Service


* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements.
* Manage parts or all of the engagement, providing support to the Managing Director/ Director (or often directly to Senior Managing Director) in managing external stakeholders.
* Managing insolvency engagements under the *Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act*, the *Companies’ Creditors Arrangement Act and other statutes.*
* Support management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short term cash flow forecasts and Financial Advisory plans.
* Providing comprehensive financial restructuring and cash management services to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress\-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact\-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Establishment or enhancement of company finance functions and processes.
* Develop, analyse and present Financial Advisory options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling. Liaise with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.)
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.
* Apply an understanding of financial and risk management.

Knowledge Acquisition


* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and Leadership


* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on\-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business Development


* Start to own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Director/ Managing Director/Senior Managing Director\-led marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand engagments as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

**Key Skills \& Experience**
----------------------------


* Qualified accountant (CPA or equivalent), both time and exam qualified.
* Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank; as an analyst in a debt or special situations funds. An understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisors).
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options. A basic understanding of insolvency legislation and practice is not a prerequisite but helpful
